title: Tahiri (Spiced Vegetable Rice)
tagline: A humble, comforting one-pot of rice with potatoes and peas in gentle spices.
intro: Tahiri (or tehri) is homely comfort food — a lightly spiced, often meat-free rice dish with potatoes and peas that's especially loved in Uttar Pradesh and across Pakistan. Simple, warming and economical, it's the kind of everyday meal that feels like home.

items: 400 g (2 cups) basmati rice, soaked 20 min
½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder
Whole spices: cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf

method: Heat oil, add cumin and whole spices, then onions; fry until golden.
Add ginger–garlic paste, chillies and tomatoes; cook until soft.
Add the ground spices, potatoes, peas and carrot; sauté for 3–4 minutes.
Add the drained rice and stir gently. Add water and salt.
Boil, then cover and cook on low until absorbed and the potatoes are tender, 15 minutes.
tips: Cut the potatoes small so they cook in the same time as the rice.
toServe: Lovely with plain yoghurt, pickle and papad.
imageAlt: Tahiri spiced rice with potatoes and peas
